identityReview: Matched Cristina Helena Zingaretti Junqueira, Brazilian Nubank cofounder, across company management biography, Kellogg alumni feature and US launch release. Wikipedia gives September 1982; retain only 1982 and no exact birthday. Distinguished cofounders David Vélez and Edward Wible and adjacent executives in search results.
lifeStatusEvidence: September 10, 2026 official US launch release quotes Junqueira as cofounder and CEO of Nu US. Current management page lists group chief growth officer and US CEO. November 12-authorized quarterly financial statements corroborate the US launch and conditional charter status.

sourceReview.accessMethod: Read relevant management biography and Kellogg alumni feature, official September 2026 US launch and January conditional-approval announcements, OCC-hosted application cover, selected company-history and IPO passages of 2025 Form 20-F, official Spanish timeline, selected US operations passages of Q3 2026 statements, and Wikipedia birth/identity passages.
sourceReview.scope: Identity, degrees, three cofounders, early card milestones, IPO, group role and US regulatory/operating distinction.
corrections: Company biography confirms engineering bachelor’s and master’s degrees from USP and Kellogg MBA. Kellogg confirms One-Year MBA completed in 2008 after arriving in 2007. No PhD, unsupported master’s field or degree years imported from aggregated biographies.
Kellogg discusses prior consulting and subsequent banking career. Company confirms Itaú Unibanco consumer credit, cards and marketing. Employer history is not a claim she founded the incumbent bank.
Official Spanish timeline places three-person founding in May 2013 in São Paulo: David Vélez, Edward Wible and Cristina Junqueira. Preserve joint and team contributions.
First card transaction April 1, 2014 and public card launch September 2014 are different milestones. Timeline uses public launch; annual report corroborates the product year.
December 9, 2021 NYSE IPO is a corporate event. No transient billionaire ranking, proceeds-to-person claim or assertion she personally received the company financing.
Official management page dates group chief growth officer from August 2022. David Vélez remains group CEO; her US CEO title must not replace his group role.
September 30, 2025 OCC-hosted application cover confirms submission for proposed Nubank, N.A.; a submitted application is neither approval nor operational launch.
January 29, 2026 approval was preliminary and conditional. Company announcement describes outstanding OCC conditions and FDIC/Federal Reserve requirements, not fully completed authorisation.

September 10, 2026 company release quotes her as Nu US CEO and launches products via Lead Bank. In the US, Nu describes itself as a fintech, not a bank; banking services and credit card are provided by Lead Bank, Member FDIC. No rates or promotional benefits retained.

Q3 statements authorized November 12, 2026 say Nu United States LLC commenced operations through Lead Bank and describe final charter approval as contingent. Thus management biography wording about future US banking operations is not evidence that no US products have launched, and product launch is not proof of final charter approval.
Birth only 1982 from Wikipedia; nationality Brazilian. No family details needed. No imported accolades or universal financial-inclusion outcome claims.
sourceReview.limits: AI authored and reviewed, not human/native-language certified. Selected public filing passages, not a full financial audit or full regulatory dossier review. Corporate market claims not independently validated.
